red_cases.classification: Contract disagreement: native grep.pattern is a regex, not a path.

red_cases.case: B5 runner timeout-cut sends TERM/KILL and retains usage as error
red_cases.contract: B5-32 requires timed_out true/status error for a timed-out session; the brief explicitly requests the cut-mid-line timeout case. B5-31 independently classifies malformed JSONL as harness invalid.
red_cases.actual: A timed-out stream with complete text/stop events followed by an incomplete JSON line retains usage and sends TERM/KILL, but becomes invalid with reason harness failure: malformed JSONL and is archived under _invalid.
red_cases.classification: Conflicting timeout/malformed rules need a precedence ruling. The case defends timeout/error for a final line cut by termination. The same complete-line timeout passes.
